column1: # Hogwarts Legacy: Avalanche Software (Warner Bros. Games), Unreal Engine 4 (version 11 paks with IoStore containers and shader code archives), SDK 17.5.4, NVN, Wwise sound, Bink 2 movies; update 1.0.5.
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py) and brought up on the Mac (docs/agents): see README.md beside this file
# subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie (main imports from it)
# Unreal: nninitStartup reserves a 62 GB address region and its allocator takes 37 GB of it, so a 64 GB alias region for the Mac (address space, not memory: 3.2 GB resident after 600 frames).
# The rewriter's engine region gate applies (main+0x19ed298: the region gets what the alias region has room for, dm/tools/ue_region.py), but its FMallocBinned3 cut (dm/tools/ue_malloc.py) does not
# recognize this build (main.cuts.tsv is empty, the alias region maps up to +37.25 GB), so the block is too large for an iPhone until it does (README.md, Open)
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# the NVN depth mode the game sets (nvnDeviceSetDepthMode near = 0): the pipeline archive made offline holds the main0_z vertex entries (dm/gfx/tools/pso_offline.py); without the key the
# host rejected the bundled archive ("made for … depth near=-w … this run needs … depth near=0") and compiled the bases on the Mac itself
# The decoded shader code archives in the IoStore containers: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders (65,047 shaders), each one Oodle-compressed; the NSP script decodes
# them on the Mac with the game's own Oodle (uepak.py, DM_OODLE_JOB), as for any game with Unreal paks
# the note is a shader_* key and so part of the library inputs digest (dmsh_chain.py inputs): changing its wording rebuilds the libraries, so the provisional wording stays until the next full rebuild

# address regions: 2026-10-31, in its first 15 s in nnMain the game's regions reach alias +62.06 GB, within the profile's 64.00 GB alias region (what it takes later in play is not measured here) (rewrite 77a997f15078)
